ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a dissected animal specimen laid open on a white background, held with pins and marked with labels A through I around internal/body structures. Reasoning: The question asks for the name of a tissue made of fibers that can contract to cause bodily movement. In anatomy, contractile fibers that produce movement are characteristic of muscle tissue. Therefore, the answer is Muscle.
